title: Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation with Representation-Level User Transfer
abstract: arXiv:2610.35550v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cross-domain sequential recommendation aims to improve next-item prediction in a target domain by leveraging user behavior from auxiliary source domains. However, real-world deployment faces two critical challenges: business constraints that isolate interaction data across domains, and user heterogeneity, where many users lack cross-domain activity. This makes existing cross-domain methods difficult to apply. In this paper, we propose a simple and practical framework for cross-domain sequential recommendations that transfers information exclusively through learned user representations, without sharing raw interaction data or item embeddings across domains. We introduce a lightweight adapter that projects the source-domain user representation into the target-domain embedding space and integrates it with the target interaction sequence. translated_title: 基于表征级用户迁移的跨域序列推荐
translated_abstract: 跨域序列推荐旨在利用来自辅助源域的用户行为来改进目标域中的下一项预测。然而，现实世界的部署面临两个关键挑战：一是隔离跨域交互数据的业务限制，二是用户异构性（即许多用户缺乏跨域活动）。这使得现有的跨域方法难以应用。在本文中，我们提出了一个简单且实用的跨域序列推荐框架，该框架仅通过学习到的用户表示来传递信息，而无需跨域共享原始交互数据或物品嵌入。我们引入了一个轻量级适配器，将源域用户表示投影到目标域嵌入空间中，并将其与目标交互序列集成。重要的是，当源数据不可用时（即用户仅在目标域中被观察到时），该框架依然能够……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种仅通过学习到的用户表示进行跨域信息迁移的简单实用的跨域序列推荐框架，利用轻量级适配器将源域用户表示投影到目标域嵌入空间并与目标交互序列融合，无需共享原始交互数据或物品嵌入，从而应对业务数据隔离和用户异构性两大挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a simple and practical cross-domain sequential recommendation framework that transfers information exclusively through learned user representations, using a lightweight adapter to project source-domain user representations into the target-domain embedding space without sharing raw interaction data or item embeddings, thereby addressing data isolation constraints and user heterogeneity.
